input.title: 2014 Ocean Kayak Tetra Angler 10
input.descriptionHtml:
Are you a fishing enthusiast looking for the perfect kayak to elevate your angling experience? Look no further! The Ocean Kayak Tetra 10 Angler Fishing Kayak is designed with you in mind. This versatile kayak offers a unique blend of compactness, comfort, and convenience, making it an excellent choice for both beginners and experienced paddlers. Let's dive into the details of what makes this kayak stand out:

Compact Yet Capable:

Length: 10 feet 8 inches
Width: 29.5 inches
Weight: 47 pounds
Weight capacity: 275 pounds

Convenience at Your Fingertips:

Easy to Launch: The Tetra 10's small and lightweight design makes it a breeze to launch, transport, and handle.
Ample Storage: Don't be fooled by its size! This kayak boasts plenty of storage space, including a Click Seal spring hatch at the front and a spacious tank well with bungee cables at the back, perfect for stowing your gear and essentials.
Comfortable Paddling: The support track foot brace system ensures a comfortable and ergonomic paddling experience, making it ideal for anglers of various sizes.
Value for Money: With the Tetra 10 Angler, you get an affordable and feature-rich kayak that won't break the bank.

Ocean Kayak Tetra 10 Angler vs. Standard Tetra 10:
The Tetra 10 Angler offers the same compact convenience as the standard Tetra 10 but with added fishing-specific features. It includes two rod holders and the Mod Pod center console for easy access to your fishing gear. With a slightly higher weight of 50 pounds, it's still a manageable choice for your fishing adventures.

Top Features:

Brand: Ocean Kayak
Model: Tetra 10 Angler
Type: Sit-on-top
Hull Material: Polyethylene
Saltwater Friendly: Yes
Adjustable Seat: Yes
Rod Holders: 2
Adjustable Leg Straps: Yes

Performance on the Water:

The Tetra 10 Angler is designed for versatility, with a V-shaped hull at the bow for increased speed and efficiency. It strikes a balance between speed and stability, making it suitable for moderate ocean waves and currents, as well as rivers and lakes.

Summary:

While the Tetra 10 may not be the choice for deep-sea fishing adventures, it excels as a compact, stable, and easily maneuverable kayak for farm ponds, calm lakes, and leisurely day fishing trips. Its lightweight construction ensures that it's a breeze for a single person to load, transport, and launch. Plus, the included Gunnel rails allow you to customize your kayak with electronic equipment and rod holders.

Compact size (10'8" length, 29.5" width) Lightweight (47 pounds) Weight capacity of 275 pounds Click Seal spring hatch Spacious tank well with bungee cables Support track foot brace system Comfort Hybrid seat Adjustable foot braces Padded rubber leg straps Brown Camo and Urban Camo color options Polyethylene hull material Saltwater friendly Two rod holders Mod Pod center console Gunnel rails for customization Sit-on-top design
